CITY OF ALHAMBRA

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 3:  2513 South Fremont Avenue, DRB-2024-00005

  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

ITEM 4:  2130 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00038

  •  Applicant: Wei Xiong – Absent

  2
 MOTION:

ITEM 5:  2100 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00215

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 6-foot-high wrought iron fence along
  the north, west, and south side of the property limits, and one (1) new wrought
  iron double-swing gate.
  •  Applicant: Darren Gilbert
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed
  project is approved with the following conditions of approval:
  1) Provide an 3rd horizontal rail on the upper portion of the fence that adds
  articulation to the overall fence design. This rail could be attached to the
  existing fence and should match the black wrought iron finish. The applicant
  may consider add the 3rd rail to the top of the fence to conceal the pointed
  tops.
  2) The applicant shall provide an alternative fence top that does not contain any
  pointed spears or ornamentation. Consider providing a 3rd rail to the very top
  or cutting off the points to achieve square pickets / tops.
  3) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with
  conditions as follows:
  1) The applicate shall provide a note on the plans identifying the artificial
  vines/planting on the fence.
  •  The second was by Board member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 6:  2528 West Commonwealth Avenue, DRB-2024-00010

  •  Request: This is an application for new wall signage, clearance arm, directional

  3
